name: tilttek/advent-calendar-bundle
description: tilttek/advent-calendar in Symfony: calendars in configuration or the database, each box opened once, a screen that works without JavaScript and a celebration.

suggest.doctrine/orm: To edit the calendars in the database, with their form, and to add the table of the openings to the schema the ORM generates, and so to the migrations
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: To export and erase a member's openings with the rest of their account
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipes Card, Badge, Button and Alert the screen is built of, and Celebration for a first opening, through the Symfony UX Toolkit
suggest.symfony/console: For the commands that list the calendars, show the boxes of one and check those of the database
suggest.symfony/stimulus-bundle: For the controller that opens a box in the background and announces it
suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: For the screen, built of the recipes of a kit of the Symfony UX Toolkit
